sentences.en: It's unusual for defensive players to score many goals.
sentences.zh: 1. 对于防守型球员来说，进球很多是不寻常的。

sentences.en: Don't cross your arms. It makes you seem defensive.
sentences.zh: 2. 别抱臂了。这会让你显得在防御。

sentences.en: Muhammad, peace be upon him, fought defensive wars.
sentences.zh: 3. 穆罕默德（愿他平安）进行了自卫战争。

senses.zh: 防御用的;防守的;守势的
守势;防守处于防御姿态；处于戒备状态；采取守势
